reuse.why: expectedAmount is computed by the existing shared getScheduledAmount from the raw _amount, the same helper the forecast, preview and posting paths use.

placement.why: The field is mapped in scheduleModel.toExternal, the API model layer, and typed through a dedicated list entity in api-handlers.

scope.why: The change is the field, its read-only type, the handler signature and a test, nothing else.

maintainability.why: A separate APIScheduleListEntity keeps the derived field out of the create/update input type, and the derivation delegates to the canonical helper.
